items.title: Ebola outbreak may be spreading faster than first thought, WHO doctor warns
items.description: Hundreds of cases are suspected in central Africa but experts fear the actual number may be much higher.

items.title: Father-of-eight killed in San Diego mosque shooting hailed as hero
items.description: Security guard Amin Abdullah, one of three killed in the attack, was described as "a shining light".

items.title: Victim or enabler? Epstein girlfriend who could face questions despite plea deal
items.description: Nadia Marcinko is relatively unknown but may soon be called before US legislators.

items.title: Son of Mango boss arrested over father's fatal fall from cliff
items.description: Isak, 71, died in December 2024 after falling from a ravine while walking in the Montserrat mountains near Barcelona.

items.title: Selling children to survive: Afghan fathers forced to make impossible choices
items.description: In Afghanistan today, a staggering three in four people cannot meet their basic needs.

items.title: Two bodies of missing Italians recovered from inside Maldives cave
items.description: The two were among four divers located in the furthest chamber in the cave and their bodies were recovered by specialist divers.

items.title: Uncontrolled California wildfires seen from space
items.description: Some 750 firefighters are tackling the uncontrolled blazes supported by water-dropping helicopters.

items.title: Jackson Pollock painting sells for record $181m at auction
items.description: The Abstract Expressionist's Number 7A, 1948 painting is now his most expensive artwork ever sold at auction.

items.title: Two dead in Spain shooting, with babies reportedly among injured
items.description: Police say a 25-year-old man is suspected of killing his parents and injuring four others in southern Spain.

items.title: Tasmanian government apologises over stolen body parts scandal
items.description: An investigation found that 177 human specimens from dozens of bodies were secretly kept by a museum.

items.title: Starbucks Korea sacks CEO over controversial 'Tank Day' promotion
items.description: Starbucks withdrew the campaign for its drink tumblers after many said it referenced a bloody crackdown.

items.title: Trump says he called off new Iran attack at request of Gulf states
items.description: The US president says he is holding off on an attack planned for Tuesday as "serious negotiations are now taking place".
